item.text:
Audited all 63 Roman verses against their Urdu counterparts in [sheh-ke-azadaro.md](src/data/lyrics/sheh-ke-azadaro.md). Both versions already contained 63 verses. I corrected Roman spellings and readings, separated the opening from stanza 1, and numbered nine stanzas in both versions using the existing refrains as boundaries. The Urdu verse wording was preserved.

Two readings remain for editorial review. The Urdu `تم س` appears to be missing the final letter of `سے`, so I retained the existing Roman reading `tum se`. The unusual `غم گا` remains `Gham ga` pending confirmation. `git diff --check` passed.
